findings.summary: Interactive REPL --tag parsing only captures a single whitespace-delimited token, silently truncating multi-word tags and leaking the remainder into the title
workflow/PROJECT.md links the new 'Malformed tags (import)' entry to docs/adr/0001-tags-import-abort.md, which does not exist; the ADR added by this PR is docs/adr/0034-tags-import-abort.md
Imported tags are stored as-is (no trim/lowercase) unlike tags added via --tag, so an imported tag with stray whitespace will never match filter --tag
